name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; domain=battle is correct (battle pathfind state). 'best_path_length' accurately names the semantics: a single-byte running minimum of the shortest path/step depth found so far during the directional DFS (0xFF=unreachable sentinel, 0=origin==destination, else N steps). No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve. Datatype reflected (a byte counter).
purpose: Single-byte running minimum of the shortest pathfind step depth reached at the destination during the current search; also the return value of fd2_pathfind_to_destination (0xFF=unreachable, 0=origin already is destination, else N steps).
logic_summary: Init=0xFF sentinel by fd2_pathfind_to_destination right after zeroing current_depth (0x4E261), then returned by that orchestrator as the result (XOR EAX,EAX; MOV AL,[0x60078] @ 0x4E275). fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path does an UNSIGNED depth-vs-best guard (CMP AH,[0x60078]; JA @ 0x4E417) and on pass stores the current depth as the new best (MOV [0x60078],AH @ 0x4E41F) -- the store happens BEFORE the depth-nonzero guard (OR AH,AH;JZ), so a zero-depth arrival still lowers best to 0. fd2_pathfind_record_destination_xy force-sets it to 1 on a mode-2 one-step destination commit (MOV [0x60078],1 @ 0x4E3C6). Write-before-read: the orchestrator overwrites it with 0xFF before any reader runs, so the BSS load value is never observed.
element_semantics: Scalar unsigned byte. Value = shortest path length / DFS depth reached so far at the destination. 0xFF = no path found yet / unreachable; 0 = origin tile already is the destination; 1..N = number of steps in the best path. Not an array (adjacent bytes belong to separate globals).
comment_original_issue: src comment block (lines 900-918) was already accurate and consistent with the disassembly (unsigned compare, store-before-depth-guard subtlety, mode-2 force-set to 1, 0xFF sentinel, write-before-read). No issue. The Ghidra-side annotation (PRE_COMMENT) footer claimed 'emit_action = emit_c_const', which contradicts the non-const nature (3 game writers @ 0x4E261/0x4E3C6/0x4E41F); corrected in the plate to reflect non-const.
notes: Datatype byte/uint8 matches src declaration (uint8 data_fd2_battle_pathfind_best_path_length;). is_const=false: 3 game write-xrefs (0x4E261 init 0xFF, 0x4E3C6 force-set 1, 0x4E41F store new best); src correctly emits plain non-const BSS uint8. Plate annotation lives in PRE_COMMENT (not PLATE_COMMENT); only the contradicting 'emit_c_const' footer line was corrected in place to 'emit_c (non-const: 3 game writers...)', semantic body left intact as it already matched src; save_program succeeded. src/util/pathfnd.c was NOT modified (comment_verdict=keep).
